Then, click on the “**Earnings**” tab. The **Earnings Summary** tab provides information on the next scheduled earnings date, estimates for earnings per share (EPS), revenue, and more. The **EPS Surprise & Estimates by Quarter** chart shows the company's earnings results quarter by quarter, compared with analyst estimates. Click on the **Earnings Estimates** tab to view past and future earnings estimates. Below, one can find revenue estimates - past and future. Click on the **Earnings Revisions** tab to see the history of analyst revisions to earnings and revenue. Click on the **Earnings Surprise** tab to compare the company's earnings and revenue results with analyst consensus. Click the **Transcripts & Insights** tab to view transcripts or listen to quarterly investor calls. **Earnings Calls Insights** are AI-generated summaries of earnings call transcripts by Seeking Alpha, helping you stay informed effortlessly. You can also find the **Earnings Calls Insights** under the “**News**” section of the left-nav bar.
